description: Turn word pairs into real spoonerisms — 'light fire' becomes 'fight lire' — using true initial-consonant-cluster swapping.

faqs.a: A spoonerism swaps the initial sounds of two words: 'light fire' → 'fight lire'. This tool swaps the leading consonant clusters for real.
The initial consonant cluster is every consonant before the first vowel: 'str' in 'street', 'ch' in 'chair'. Those clusters trade places.
Yes — try the random examples button for classic-style pairs like 'blushing crow' → 'crushing blow'.
For vowel-initial words the swap still applies (an empty cluster trades with the other word's cluster).
faqs.q: What about words starting with vowels?

howto: Enter two words (or a phrase — the first two words are used).
Try Random Pair for instant examples.
title: Spoonerism Generator
